report:
# PRFlow Shadow Review — PR #1910 (issue #1889)

**Verdict: REJECT**

**Reviewed HEAD:** d1de1075f23f17d4dffdaa4bbb7f1a44362c1448  
**Dispatch mode:** fanned-out (blinded shadow)  
**Diff profile:** engine_self_modifying=true, config_only=false, has_new_types=false, small_diff=false, checklist_skipped=false

## Summary

The change generalizes the review engine's displaced-path routing into a standalone "diff-touched arm": in standalone PR-number mode a claim about a diff-touched path is verified against the reviewed head's bytes via `git show $PR_HEAD_SHA:<path>` (base via `$PR_BASE_SHA`) rather than the default-branch working tree. The diff is entirely agent-executed prompt prose, workflow comments, internal docs, and a changeset — no executable code. Nine of ten acceptance criteria are satisfied and the prose is careful, but there is one genuine end-to-end break in the exact mechanism the PR exists to deliver.

## Blocking finding (all four Phase-3 reviewers converged independently)

**The diff-touched arm's Head SHA / Base SHA operand is never delivered to the five first-party Phase-3 agent dispatch templates.**

- The shared `defect_signature` contract (`skills/review/phases/phase-3-agents.md:79`, pasted verbatim into every Phase-3 dispatch) and the amended agent bodies `agents/code-reviewer.md:74` and `agents/comment-analyzer.md:87` instruct each agent to route a diff-touched-path claim through `git show <PR_HEAD_SHA>:<path>`, substituting the commit id "as a literal from this dispatch's Head SHA / Base SHA lines."
- But of the six Phase-3 dispatch templates, only the `requesting-code-review` final-pass prompt (lines 129-130) actually carries `Head SHA:` / `Base SHA:` lines. The five first-party templates — `code-reviewer` (84-89), `silent-failure-hunter` (91-96), `comment-analyzer` (98-103), `pr-test-analyzer` (105-110), `type-design-analyzer` (112-117) — receive only `{DIFF_PATH}` plus the pasted contract. No instruction (analogous to the line-65 defect_signature paste rule) injects the SHA lines into them.
- The author demonstrably knew the delivery line was required: the sibling Phase 2.1b checklist-verifier dispatch was amended correctly, adding `phase-2-verification.md:175` — "Reviewed head/base for routing (standalone PR-number mode only): {the orchestrator substitutes the resolved $PR_HEAD_SHA and $PR_BASE_SHA as literals}." The equivalent was omitted from the Phase-3 specialist templates.
- **Failure scenario:** a standalone cloud `/prflow:review` on `devflow.yml` (tree pinned to the default branch). `code-reviewer` or `comment-analyzer` — the two carriers AC1 names by agent body — verifies a documented-falsehood claim about a diff-touched path. It has the `<PR_HEAD_SHA>` placeholder but no literal SHA, and cannot use `$PR_HEAD_SHA` shell expansion (the command-tier matcher denies argument-position expansion, as the arm itself states). Working-tree fallback is forbidden, so a compliant agent grades every such claim INCONCLUSIVE; a less-literal agent silently reads the default-branch working tree — the exact false-FAIL/false-PASS wrong-bytes corruption this PR set out to eliminate. Either way AC1's promise ("route diff-touched-path claims via git show head") is unmet for two of its seven carriers, and the §7/§15/changeset claim that all seven carriers route even when the displaced list is empty is true in letter but inert-or-unsafe for those two surfaces.
- **Remedy:** add a standalone-mode `Head SHA:` / `Base SHA:` literal line to each first-party Phase-3 dispatch template (mirroring `phase-2-verification.md:175` and the final-pass lines 129-130), or add a single "append the Head SHA / Base SHA lines to every Phase-3 dispatch prompt" rule; additionally pin the missing-line case fail-closed in the agent bodies ("no Head SHA line -> INCONCLUSIVE, never the working tree").

This matches CLAUDE.md's `unverified-assumption` bug class: a guard (the routing) reads an operand (the dispatch's Head/Base SHA lines) the producer (the per-agent dispatch template) does not emit, so it fails open exactly where it claims to fail closed.

## Secondary finding (Suggestion)

**checklist-verifier label mismatch.** `agents/checklist-verifier.md:61` tells the agent to read head/base from "this dispatch's Head SHA / Base SHA lines," but the checklist-verifier dispatch prompt (`phase-2-verification.md:175`) labels the injected line "Reviewed head/base for routing." The values are present and resolvable, so this is non-blocking, but the labels should be aligned.

## Verified correct (no findings)

- **AC2** routed-read error -> `git cat-file -e` probe -> INCONCLUSIVE, no working-tree/fetch fallback: present in all carriers.
- **AC3** untouched path keeps working-tree read, prose states it: present in every carrier.
- **AC4** new `phase-0-setup.md` §0.3.7 records equal/divergent/unestablished via `git rev-parse HEAD` vs `$PR_API_HEAD_SHA`, read-only, non-verdict-changing, non-stopping.
- **AC5** displaced-list arm text retained unchanged; diff-touched arm appended independently.
- **AC6/AC9** grants verified against `lib/capability-profiles.json`: `git show`/`git cat-file`/`git rev-parse` on both cloud profiles (zero new grants); `git fetch` ungranted on `review`, granted on `command`, matching the reworded fetch clause.
- **AC7/AC8** `devflow.yml` checkout-rationale + trusted-closure comments and `DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md` §7/§15 + `cloud-setup.md` reworded to head-bytes-via-`git show`, tree-never-moves; the "PR read only via gh pr diff/gh pr view" and "git diff origin/main...HEAD for standalone" implications removed.
- **AC10** changeset present and accurate.
- **run.sh prose pins:** no regression — the reworded `devflow.yml`/overview sentences are not pinned; the `origin/main...HEAD` hits in `lib/test/run.sh` are behavioral fixtures (scenarios #503/#511), not prose pins on the reworded comment; the #504 AC6 pins (phase-2.1a `grep the \`git show <head>:<path>\` output`, phase-2.1b `displaced-path routing: for any referenced file`, the three agent-mirror `.prflow/tmp/displaced-paths.txt` pins) still match unchanged literals.

## Disposition

One small, mechanical omission from correct. Adding the head/base literal lines to the five first-party Phase-3 dispatch templates would clear the REJECT.
